# How CI splits the Godot test suites across parallel jobs
# (.github/workflows/tests.yml). One line per shard: its number, a colon, then
# the suites it runs. The suites are the runners on disk (every
# tests/run_<suite>_tests.gd); nothing lists them by hand. A suite added since
# this plan joins the lightest shard on its own (about 60 s until it is timed),
# and a removed one is dropped: tools/ci_shards.py does both on every CI run.
#
# Do not edit the lines below by hand: re-plan from a full green main run
# (weekly) with
#   gh run download <run> -p 'suite-timings-*' -D <dir>
#   python3 tools/plan_ci_shards.py --timings-dir <dir> --run <run> --shards 12
# balance, league_balance and calibration are planned last because most pull
# requests skip them.
# --- plan ---
# From main run 43577153380 (2026-11-15), 131 suites, by tools/plan_ci_shards.py --shards 12.
# Pull-request suite seconds per shard: 466 466 465 462 466 462 462 462 462 462 465 465
